topic: Screw, Pulley, and Wheel and Axle
key_concepts: Simple machines change the amount and/or direction of force
A screw is an inclined plane wrapped around a central cylinder
Screws fasten things such as nuts and bolts
Drill bits are screws used to make holes
A jackscrew is a screw used to lift heavy objects
A pulley is a grooved wheel that turns around an axle with a rope or chain
A fixed pulley is attached to something that does not move and changes the direction of fo
A movable pulley is free to move up and down or left and right
A block and tackle pulley combines fixed and movable pulleys to lift heavy objects
A wheel and axle consists of a round wheel and a cylindrical axle
Force in a wheel and axle is applied either to the wheel or to the axle
Wheel and axle devices can lift heavy objects, move people fast, and form parts of complex
